test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Flufy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is **'Fluffy', **which means light, soft, or airy, often used to describe things like pillows, clouds, or animals with lots of fur.
 
• It is often used to describe things such as fur or fabric that has a lot of fur on it.(मुलायम)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Fluffy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of all the words:
 
 
• **'Gifted' **- Having exceptional talent or natural ability.(प्रतिभाशाली)
 
• **'Juggler' -** A person who can keep several objects in motion in the air at the same time by alternately tossing and catching them. (शारीरिक कौशल दिखाने वाला)
 
• **'Struggler' -** A person who is striving to achieve something or who is engaging in a difficult effort or challenge. (संघर्षरत)
 
 

40:T4d0,
The correct answer is 'Option 2'</strong
